reviews.originalText: From the first WhatsApp message to my last check-up, the team explained every step clearly. The coordinator arranged the airport transfer and hotel, and the doctor was calm and confident. I felt looked after the whole time.
reviews.ownerReply: Thank you Hannah — it was a pleasure to look after you. Wishing you a smooth recovery.

reviews.originalText: Çok profesyonel bir ekip. Klinik tertemiz ve personel çok ilgiliydi. Sonuçtan çok memnunum.
reviews.translatedText: A very professional team. The clinic was spotless and the staff were very attentive. I am very happy with the result.

reviews.originalText: فريق رائع وتواصل ممتاز قبل وبعد العملية. أنصح به بشدة.
reviews.translatedText: A wonderful team and excellent communication before and after the procedure. I highly recommend it.
reviews.ownerReply: Thank you so much for your kind words.

reviews.originalText: Really good experience overall and a professional clinic. The only thing I'd note is that the first day ran a little behind schedule, but the staff kept me informed throughout.
The hotel and transfers were all arranged for me, which made travelling from abroad so much easier. Natural-looking result and a lovely, caring team.
Sehr empfehlenswert. Der Arzt war sehr erfahren und das Personal sehr freundlich. Die Klinik ist modern und sauber.
reviews.translatedText: Highly recommended. The doctor was very experienced and the staff very friendly. The clinic is modern and clean.

reviews.originalText: The medical care itself was good and I'm happy with the result. Communication in the first week could have been a little quicker, but the follow-up afterwards was thorough and reassuring.
reviews.ownerReply: Thank you for the honest feedback Priya — we've shared it with the coordination team and we're glad the follow-up gave you reassurance.

reviews.originalText: Professional from start to finish. The doctor inspired confidence and answered all of my questions patiently.
Lovely modern clinic and genuinely kind staff. They checked on me after the surgery which I really appreciated.
Good value and a professional team. Would have liked a little more detail in the aftercare leaflet, but the team answered everything on WhatsApp.
I travelled on my own and felt completely safe and supported the whole time. The coordinator spoke perfect English and Arabic.
Excellent experience. Clean, modern facilities and a confident surgical team. The result looks natural.
Très bonne clinique, équipe professionnelle et à l'écoute. Je recommande pour les patients internationaux.
reviews.translatedText: Very good clinic, professional and attentive team. I recommend it for international patients.

reviews.originalText: Warm, calm and professional. They made a daunting trip feel manageable and the follow-up care was excellent.
